global_posts.text: Times Higher Education reveals SDG impact winners — Universities across the globe celebrated for measurable Sustainable Development Goal progress in the 2024 Impact Rankings. AZMIU connection: Green Campus Living Lab. Our Green Campus initiative tracks energy efficiency retrofits and student-led sustainability audits across AZMIU facilities.

UNESCO spotlights campus-led climate resilience research — A new UNESCO brief profiles institutions aligning curriculum and research to accelerate community resilience under SDG 13. AZMIU connection: Water-Sensitive Building Materials. Materials science teams innovate low-impact construction materials that safeguard water resources and advance SDG 6.

UN SDSN launches global SDG innovation challenge — Student teams worldwide are invited to prototype solutions supporting SDG-aligned urban futures and regenerative infrastructure. AZMIU connection: Urban Resilience Design Studio. Faculty and graduate researchers co-develop resilient urban planning models supporting SDG 11 across Azerbaijan's regions.

azmiu_posts.text: AZMIU patent secures adaptive facade system for energy-neutral towers — The Faculty of Architecture has patented a dynamic facade module that reduces annual cooling demand in Baku's coastal developments by 32%.
Joint journal publication on resilient Caspian waterfronts — AZMIU researchers co-authored a Q1 journal article outlining climate-ready design codes for coastal districts under SDG 11 and 13.
Students win SDG design studio challenge — Urban planning students delivered inclusive neighbourhood prototypes that align with Azerbaijan's Voluntary National Review targets.
